lines: Hey, to you I love so much
Listen without laughing
Saying "I love you" sounds cheesy
But I can’t convey anything else
See? You laughed again at my foolishness
Was it right that you chose a life with me?
I don’t know, but…
Through days of crying and laughing
Just by standing beside you
It becomes the reason I live
This love song I dedicate to you
Hey, what were we talking about that day?
On the day we first met, we were distant
Since then many things happened, even fights at times
We spent moments to understand each other
Under this wide sky we share
We met and fell in love
Forever
Through days of crying and laughing
Just by standing beside you
Living with you becomes my purpose
This love song I dedicate to you
I’m always sorry for the trouble I cause
We spent intensely dense moments together
The two of us carve each day
Building the yearning we’ve created
I’ll give you this clumsy song
I’ll swear to God, I love you madly
From now on I’ll keep holding your hand
As long as my voice continues
I’ll sing love beside you forever
When we grow old and my voice hoarsens
I’ll keep holding your hand
Just saying thank you can’t express it all
Through tears, laughter, sorrow and joy
Let’s share them together and live
Across countless nights
I will sing love with you
